subject.title: fix(models): add provider request rate limits

question: Should OpenClaw accept this PR's provider-dispatch-only rate-limit config as the first core slice of the broader outbound limits work?
rationale: The PR adds a public config surface and new provider request failure mode while intentionally leaving budgets, status/CLI, tool/channel calls, and backoff out of scope; automation cannot choose that API boundary safely.

options.title: Provider Dispatch First
options.body: Approve the narrow opt-in provider HTTP pacing layer after a rebase preserves current egress safeguards and focused tests remain green.

options.title: Broader Design First
options.body: Pause this PR until maintainers define the shared limits, budgets, status, and non-provider-call model in the canonical tracker.

options.title: Close Until Sponsored
options.body: Close this contributor PR as product-direction-unconfirmed and invite a maintainer-sponsored replacement when the scope is approved.

recommendation.title: Provider Dispatch First
recommendation.body: Approve the narrow opt-in provider HTTP pacing layer after a rebase preserves current egress safeguards and focused tests remain green.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest current signal on the provider egress/config boundary and prior canonical issue scoping.
